title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 399 (Inspection, production and evidence of documents kept by Registrar)

content.overview: Documents filed with the Registrar may be inspected, and a copy or extract certified by the Registrar is admissible in evidence.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: Documents filed with the Registrar may be inspected, and a copy or extract certified by the Registrar is admissible in evidence.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Inspection is on payment of the fee. A certificate of incorporation and a certified copy of a filed document are evidence of the contents.
